findings.source_quote:
Then, with my waking thoughts
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs
Bethel I'll raise;
So by my woes to be
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

findings.location: source.html — second paragraph (mother's cause of death)
findings.source_quote: When she was five years old, her mother died of consumption, known today as tuberculosis.
findings.suggested_fix:
Adjust the parenthetical explanation so it preserves the original time/reference relation: consumption was the historical term; today the disease is called tuberculosis. Suggested concise Greek phrasing to replace the parenthetical in the existing paragraph (keep HTML tags):

«Όταν ήταν πέντε ετών, η μητέρα της πέθανε από consumption — ό,τι σήμερα ονομάζεται φυματίωση.»

or alternately: «Όταν ήταν πέντε ετών, η μητέρα της πέθανε από το νόσημα που τότε ονομαζόταν “consumption” και σήμερα καλείται φυματίωση.»
findings.translation_quote: Όταν ήταν πέντε ετών, η μητέρα της πέθανε από φυματίωση (τότε ονομάζονταν «consumption»).
